important_disclaimer: Estimated Danish normal/reference prices. Not exact shelf prices or guaranteed local-store prices. Current verified offers always override these values.

methodology.description: Representative basket of 200 commonly purchased household groceries. Estimates are informed by current Danish supermarket price-comparison data, retailer/offer observations, and offer snapshots in this repository.
methodology.primary_external_reference: Goma (goma.gg): current, normal and historical grocery price comparison across Danish supermarkets.
methodology.priority_rule: verified current offer > verified future offer valid for target date > verified store-specific price > reference price estimate
methodology.refresh_recommendation: quarterly or when grocery price levels materially change

refresh_policy.rule: Only update an item's reference price when there is a reasonable current data basis. Otherwise keep the previous value.
